# 水晶的呼唤 / Call for Crystals

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)

## 如何开始 How it starts

- “可食用水晶”结局6825.b（需使用食物）设行星旗标edible_crystals与国家旗标discovered_edible_crystals；之后在该行星建成采矿站时(on_building_mining_station)，隐藏事件6830（仅一次）触发。  
  Outcome 6825.b (food-using empires) sets the planet flag edible_crystals and country flag discovered_edible_crystals; when a mining station is later finished there (on_building_mining_station) hidden event 6830 fires once.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 6830在1700-1900天后触发6835“水晶请愿”：a在边境内最多3颗小行星添加食物资源点d_food_3；b得凝聚力。  
  6830 fires 6835 after 1800 days (+/-100): a adds d_food_3 to up to 3 asteroids inside borders; b gives unity.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 两个选项互斥。  
  The two options are exclusive.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特别差异。  
  No notable variants.
